name: Patagonia
tagline: In business to save our home planet
rundown: Patagonia is an American outdoor-apparel company famous for durable gear and radical environmental activism. Founder Yvon Chouinard built it around an anti-consumerism ethos, and in 2022 he gave the company away so that its profits fund fighting the climate crisis.

timeline.event: Yvon Chouinard founds Patagonia, growing it out of his climbing-gear business.
Runs its 'Don't Buy This Jacket' anti-consumerism ad on Black Friday.
Chouinard transfers ownership to a trust and nonprofit so profits fund environmental causes.

notableFacts: Its mission statement is "We're in business to save our home planet."
It pledges 1% of sales to environmental groups through '1% for the Planet,' which Chouinard co-founded.
In 2022 the founder gave the company away rather than sell it or go public.
